options: A legally binding offer to a specific person
A legally non-binding declaration of willingness to sell directed at the general public
A legally valid order placed by the buyer
questions.correctAnswer: A legally non-binding declaration of willingness to sell directed at the general public

questions.text: An inquiry (Anfrage) legally obligates the buyer to purchase the requested goods.
What are the 5 mandatory components that a sales contract must contain?
questions.correctAnswer: Specific seller, specific buyer, quality (product type), quantity, and price.

questions.text: Which of the following clauses is an exemption clause that makes an offer non-binding (provisional)?
How long is a binding oral offer (between present parties) valid if no specific time limit is given?
options: Only for the duration of the conversation
questions.correctAnswer: Only for the duration of the conversation

questions.text: When is an order confirmation (Auftragsbestätigung) strictly required from the seller?
questions.correctAnswer: When the order deviates from the offer, when the order is based on a non-binding offer, when the order was placed without a prior offer, or generally in B2C online shopping.

questions.text: The delivery term 'free domicile' (frei Haus) means that the buyer bears the transport costs and the risk of transport.
what does cost price (Einstandspreis / Bezugspreis) refer to?
options: The list price of the product without any deductions
The price including VAT for the end consumer
The actual price of the goods after deducting all discounts and adding any delivery costs
The price the seller paid for manufacturing
questions.correctAnswer: The actual price of the goods after deducting all discounts and adding any delivery costs

questions.text: According to the FAGG, how many days does a consumer (B2C) generally have to withdraw from an online purchase without providing a reason?
Briefly explain the difference between statutory warranty (Gewährleistung) and guarantee (Garantie).
questions.correctAnswer: Warranty is the seller's legal obligation to be liable for defects that already existed at the time of handover. Guarantee is a voluntary, additional promise of performance by the manufacturer or retailer.
